raw_text:
PLAN "12-week Strength for Stage III Endometriosis"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Increase strength and resilience"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 — Foundation (Weeks 1-4)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower strength - moderate":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper strength - moderate":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full-body - control":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5..6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower strength - progressive":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 7..8 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper strength - progressive":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7..8 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full-body - technique":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x5..6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          side_plank 3x30..45 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower strength - volume":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x6..8 rpe 7..8 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper strength - volume":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          tricep_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full-body - light":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          sumo_deadlift 3x5..6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          military_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower - deload":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper - deload":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Full-body - deload":
        warmup:
          cycling 6m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 2x3..4 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          incline_press 2x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          plank 2x30..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m

  PHASE "Phase 2 — Build (Weeks 5-8)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower strength - build":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x5..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6..8 rpe 7..8 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6..8 rpe 7..8 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Upper strength - build":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x5..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7..8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 4x6..8 rpe 7..8 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full-body - power (low-impact)":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x60..90 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower strength - build":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          sumo_deadlift 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x8..10 rpe 7..8 rest 90 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Upper strength - build":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 5x5..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7..8 rest 120 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full-body - tempo control":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x3..5 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          military_press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          side_plank 3x45..60 rpe 7..8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower - intensity":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x3..5 rpe 8..9 rest 180 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x5..7 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Upper - intensity":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3..5 rpe 8..9 rest 180 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x5..7 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 4x5..7 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full-body - control":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x3..5 rpe 8..9 rest 180 seconds
          incline_press 4x5..7 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x60..90 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower - planned deload":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x4..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper - planned deload":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x4..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Full-body - recovery":
        warmup:
          cycling 6m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 2x3..4 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          military_press 2x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          plank 2x30..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m

  PHASE "Phase 3 — Peak & Transition (Weeks 9-12)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower peak":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x3..5 rpe 8..9 rest 180 seconds
          sumo_deadlift 4x3..5 rpe 8..9 rest 180 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x5..7 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper peak":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3..5 rpe 8..9 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 4x3..5 rpe 8..9 rest 180 seconds
          overhead_press 4x5..7 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full-body - maintain":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x3..5 rpe 8..9 rest 180 seconds
          incline_press 4x5..7 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x60..90 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower - cyclical & flare-aware":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5..6 rpe 7..8 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper - cyclical & flare-aware":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5..6 rpe 7..8 rest 150 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Full-body - low impact options":
        warmup:
          cycling 6m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x3..5 rpe 7..8 rest 180 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower - taper":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x4..6 rpe 6..7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 6..7 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x6..8 rpe 6..7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper - taper":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x4..6 rpe 6..7 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x4..6 rpe 6..7 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Full-body - prep":
        warmup:
          cycling 6m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 2x3..4 rpe 6..7 rest 180 seconds
          incline_press 2x5..6 rpe 6..7 rest 120 seconds
          plank 2x30..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Recovery & transition":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Recovery & transition":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Light full-body":
        warmup:
          cycling 6m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 2x3..4 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          dumbbell_press 2x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 2x30..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
